# incident_catalog_entry_aliases (Resource)

This resource adds your own aliases to a catalog entry that incident.io syncs, such as a
schedule, escalation path or user. The sync owns the entry and its other aliases, so you
can't manage it with `incident_catalog_entry`: look it up with the
`incident_catalog_entry` data source instead.

Syncs keep these aliases, and the entry lists them in its aliases too. Terraform owns the
whole list: it removes aliases added to it elsewhere, for example in the dashboard, on the
next apply. When you destroy the resource, Terraform clears the list and leaves the entry
in place.

Only catalog types that incident.io syncs take these aliases. Changing them on the User
type, or on another type that team membership passes through, needs an API key with the
`team.memberships_update` scope ("Update team memberships"), because aliases on those
entries decide who belongs to a team.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "incident_catalog_type" "schedule" {
  type_name = "Schedule"
}

data "incident_schedule" "primary_on_call" {
  name = "Primary on-call"
}

# incident.io syncs a catalog entry for each schedule, with the schedule's ID as its
# external ID.
data "incident_catalog_entry" "primary_on_call" {
  catalog_type_id = data.incident_catalog_type.schedule.id
  identifier      = data.incident_schedule.primary_on_call.id
}

resource "incident_catalog_entry_aliases" "primary_on_call" {
  entry_id = data.incident_catalog_entry.primary_on_call.id
  aliases  = ["primary", "pd-primary-on-call"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `aliases` (Set of String) Aliases your organisation adds to the entry, beside the ones its sync sets.
- `entry_id` (String) The ID of the catalog entry, usually from the `incident_catalog_entry` data source.

## Import

Import is supported using an [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) or the [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import):

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import the custom aliases of a catalog entry, by the entry's ID
terraform import incident_catalog_entry_aliases.example 01HXYZ
```
